_context_protocol.description: Index mapping CLI version tiers to active, validated agentic skills.
_context_protocol.purpose: Controls which skills are bundled, recommended, and tested for specific major versions of the Vidbyte CLI codebase.
_context_protocol.architecture: A JSON object mapping numeric version strings to arrays of skill directory names.
key_elements: 1, 2, 3, 4 keys: arrays of certified skill names for the corresponding major CLI release version.
_context_protocol.relation_to_codebase: Read by `./scripts/validate.js` to ensure version consistency, and CLI installation commands to select version-compatible skills.
